98080086.s: Wadi Dharak is a well-known valley south of the Al Baha region in Al Mandaq Governorate. Its water flows year-round, and it has a dam and a lake with a beautiful view, plus shaded seating areas near the lake that are suitable for barbecues and camping. It remains a favorite natural destination for lovers of quiet.

98080085.s: Wadi Al Khaitan is one of the most beautiful flowing valleys in Baljurashi Governorate, known for its variety of trees, sandy soil and towering mountains. It holds rare fresh water that is home to fish, which should be protected and not harmed. The site attracts nature lovers almost all year round.

98080084.s: Athrab Waterfall is a stunning natural site in Bani Hassan Governorate, close to Khairah Forest. It features a suspended pedestrian bridge with a glass floor that offers a thrilling view of the waterfall from above. The site is known for its strong flow during the rainy season, while the flow is weaker in summer.

98080083.s: Wadi Mathood is an unspoiled natural site in Baljurashi Governorate, with a calm stream running through beautiful scenery and a small lake that holds fish. The site lacks basic services and has no mobile coverage, and it is best visited in winter, when the water flows more strongly.

98073598.s: Al Qima Dam (Al Qamma) is one of the largest, most important and best-known parks in the region, in Baljurashi Governorate about 45 km from Al Baha. It has an unspoiled natural setting with long-lived trees such as juniper, acacia and tamarisk. It offers facilities, wide green spaces, many shaded seating areas and an area for renting tents, making it an ideal destination for families and individuals.

98073596.s: Wadi Al Malad Waterfall lies next to Al Malad village in Al Baha city. It is a beautiful natural spot with flowing water that appeals to families looking for a pleasant outing, although it lacks major services. It is best visited after rainfall to enjoy its finest views, and children should be watched closely near the stream.

98073595.s: Khairah Waterfall is a beautiful natural site in Bani Hassan Governorate, with water flowing down from the mountains among striking rock formations, close to Khairah Forest. It is small but enchanting, and is best visited right after rainfall to enjoy its finest views.

Its owner is known for his love of heritage and his broad knowledge of it, and he kindly answers visitors' questions. Open daily from 4 to 10 PM. Contact: 0508866123.

Open daily from 10 AM to about 8:30 PM (on Friday from 2 PM). Contact: 0555775219.
